facts.P1_fx_receipts: Likely yes; currency controls were reportedly removed in 2009.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Likely yes; residents may reportedly hold foreign currency freely.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with the Registrar of Businesses and get a licence; needs a NIN.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from the Seychelles Revenue Commission when you register.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Under SCR 1 million turnover, a flat 1.5% presumptive tax on turnover.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% VAT above SCR 2 million; voluntary from SCR 100,000.
facts.L5_data_protection: Data Protection Act 2023, enforced by the Information Commission.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L7_incentives: The 1.5% presumptive tax below SCR 1m is the main simplification.
